steps.name: 1. Authentication / Login
steps.details: Logged in successfully. Token saved in localStorage under adpp_token.

steps.name: 2. UI Structure & Tabs
steps.details: Header has '+ Tạo cuộc thi' button and tabs [Cuộc thi & Giải đấu], [Cuộc thi của tôi], [Bảng xếp hạng].

steps.name: 3.2 Create Competition (POST /api/competitions)
steps.details: POST /api/competitions succeeded. CreatedBy taken from JWT. Status is Draft.

steps.name: 4.1 My Competitions Tab
steps.details: Newly created competition appears with status 'Bản nháp' (Draft).

steps.name: 4.2 Update (PATCH /api/competitions/{id})
steps.details: PATCH succeeded. Only modified fields sent.

steps.name: 5. Create Team Competition & Open Registration
steps.details: Team competition created and opened for registration.

steps.name: 6.2 Register Individual (POST /registrations)
steps.details: Registered without sending userId. Status is 'Đang chờ duyệt' (Pending).

steps.name: 6.3 Cancel Registration (DELETE /registrations/me)
steps.details: DELETE /me succeeded with reason payload. Status updated.

steps.name: 7.1 Create Team (POST /teams)
steps.details: Creator is Captain. Captain not in CompetitionTeamMembers. 1 Captain + max 1 member enforced.

steps.name: 7.2 Invitation Validation
steps.details: Self-invitation correctly rejected by backend validation.

steps.name: 8.1 Review Registration (PUT /approve)
steps.details: Registration approved. Status updated to Approved.

steps.name: 10. Cancel Competition (POST /cancel)
steps.details: Status transitioned to Cancelled via POST /cancel.
